data = open('/tmp/test.cram','rb').read()
# file def is 26 bytes
off = 26
# container
import struct
length = struct.unpack('<I', data[off:off+4])[0]
print('container length', length)
off += 4
# ref_seq_id itf8
def itf8_get(buf, off):
    c = buf[off]
    if not (c & 0x80):
        return c, off+1
    elif not (c & 0x40):
        return ((c&0x3f)<<8)|buf[off+1], off+2
    elif not (c & 0x20):
        return ((c&0x1f)<<16)|(buf[off+1]<<8)|buf[off+2], off+3
    elif not (c & 0x10):
        return ((c&0x0f)<<24)|(buf[off+1]<<16)|(buf[off+2]<<8)|buf[off+3], off+4
    else:
        return ((c&0x07)<<28)|(buf[off+1]<<20)|(buf[off+2]<<12)|(buf[off+3]<<4)|(buf[off+4]&0x0f), off+5
def ltf8_get(buf, off):
    c = buf[off]
    if not (c & 0x80):
        return c, off+1
    elif not (c & 0x40):
        return ((c&0x3f)<<8)|buf[off+1], off+2
    elif not (c & 0x20):
        return ((c&0x1f)<<16)|(buf[off+1]<<8)|buf[off+2], off+3
    elif not (c & 0x10):
        return ((c&0x0f)<<24)|(buf[off+1]<<16)|(buf[off+2]<<8)|buf[off+3], off+4
    elif not (c & 0x08):
        return ((c&0x07)<<32)|(buf[off+1]<<24)|(buf[off+2]<<16)|(buf[off+3]<<8)|buf[off+4], off+5
    elif not (c & 0x04):
        return ((c&0x03)<<40)|(buf[off+1]<<32)|(buf[off+2]<<24)|(buf[off+3]<<16)|(buf[off+4]<<8)|buf[off+5], off+6
    elif not (c & 0x02):
        return ((c&0x01)<<48)|(buf[off+1]<<40)|(buf[off+2]<<32)|(buf[off+3]<<24)|(buf[off+4]<<16)|(buf[off+5]<<8)|buf[off+6], off+7
    elif not (c & 0x01):
        return (buf[off+1]<<48)|(buf[off+2]<<40)|(buf[off+3]<<32)|(buf[off+4]<<24)|(buf[off+5]<<16)|(buf[off+6]<<8)|buf[off+7], off+8
    else:
        return (buf[off+1]<<56)|(buf[off+2]<<48)|(buf[off+3]<<40)|(buf[off+4]<<32)|(buf[off+5]<<24)|(buf[off+6]<<16)|(buf[off+7]<<8)|buf[off+8], off+9
ref_seq_id, off = itf8_get(data, off)
print('ref_seq_id', ref_seq_id, 'off', off)
ref_seq_start, off = itf8_get(data, off)
print('ref_seq_start', ref_seq_start, 'off', off)
ref_seq_span, off = itf8_get(data, off)
print('ref_seq_span', ref_seq_span, 'off', off)
num_records, off = itf8_get(data, off)
print('num_records', num_records, 'off', off)
record_counter, off = ltf8_get(data, off)
print('record_counter', record_counter, 'off', off)
num_bases, off = ltf8_get(data, off)
print('num_bases', num_bases, 'off', off)
num_blocks, off = itf8_get(data, off)
print('num_blocks', num_blocks, 'off', off)
num_landmarks, off = itf8_get(data, off)
print('num_landmarks', num_landmarks, 'off', off)
for i in range(num_landmarks):
    lm, off = itf8_get(data, off)
    print('landmark', i, lm, 'off', off)
crc = struct.unpack('<I', data[off:off+4])[0]
print('container crc', hex(crc), 'off', off+4)
off += 4
print('block starts at', off)
# block
method = data[off]; off+=1
content_type = data[off]; off+=1
print('method', method, 'content_type', content_type)
content_id, off = itf8_get(data, off)
print('content_id', content_id, 'off', off)
comp_size, off = itf8_get(data, off)
print('comp_size', comp_size, 'off', off)
uncomp_size, off = itf8_get(data, off)
print('uncomp_size', uncomp_size, 'off', off)
print('block data:', data[off:off+comp_size].hex())
off += comp_size
bcrc = struct.unpack('<I', data[off:off+4])[0]
print('block crc', hex(bcrc))
"
